text:
Ben: Office challenge: whoever loses the bracket pool wear a retro jersey to standup on Monday? stakes are escalating.
Karina: Wait are we talking vintage or embarrassing high school level? I need to know what I'm signing up for.
Omar: Vintage. I'm in if it's a real jersey. If it's embarrassing I'll counter with a mascot costume.
Zoe: Mascot costume?? no. but I will bring themed snacks based on the losers team colors.
Priya M: Love the energy. Quick logistics: location for watch party Saturday 6pm? kitchen or courtyard?
Hannah: Courtyard if weather holds, kitchen if not. also can someone bring an extra charger and HDMI? projector cursed my laptop last time.
Ben: Poll time: Jersey standup + themed snacks vs Mascot costume + office playlist takeover. leaguebot: created poll "Loser punishment preference?" options: Jersey / Mascot + Playlist. Voting open 24h.
leaguebot: votes recorded: Ben Jersey, Karina Jersey, Omar Mascot + Playlist, Zoe Mascot + Playlist, Priya M Jersey. Current tally 3-2.
Karina: Also side-bet: small coffee tab for the person who predicts the most upsets. Loser buys week of coffee. Fair?
Omar: Accept. Also reminder: lineup locks at 2am Sunday, check your rosters.
Zoe: Posting a spoiler etiquette reminder: no scores in #random until all games end. Put clips in #sports-highlights with spoiler tags.
Priya M: Can we add a halftime trivia? winner gets first dibs on jersey selection (or playlist choices if mascot wins).
Ben: Halftime trivia = yes. I will MC and bring sticky name tags.
Hannah: For the watch party I'm bringing two types of wings: buffalo and garlic parmesan. chores: someone handle plates?
Karina: I'll bring napkins and cups. Omar you owe us a speaker if you voted mascot.
Omar: Speaker secured. If mascot loses I will also choreograph a 30-second dance for the playlist week.
Zoe: Please record that dance for posterity. Must be GIF-able.
leaguebot: Reminder: poll closes in 8 hours. Also, bracket pool cutoff tonight at 11:59pm UTC. Good luck and keep spoilers out of #random.
Priya M: Love this. See y'all Saturday. Also I'll pin the watch-party logistics and the punishment rules to avoid future confusion.
Ben: Final note: if it's raining, kitchen it is. I'll coordinate with facilities for projector + seating.
Karina: Can't wait to see who ends up in a retro jersey. May the upsets be ever in your favor. :crossed_fingers:
